DOJO

Seishinkai Karate-do Federation – Fujino Branch

Minami-ku Fujino Karate Class – Seishinkai Fujino Branch

The Fujino Karate Class has been active since March 2011, using space kindly lent by the Fujino District Center.
We aim to focus on kids' and junior karate, welcoming participants from preschool age through junior high school. We are currently accepting trial participants!
We also welcome participation from parents and children together, as well as senior members.
While many dojos feel like an extension of a school sports club, we aim to make training feel more like a relaxed circle activity — enjoying karate as a way to build health and fitness while still learning its true spirit.

Seishinkai Karate: cultivating a spirit that never gives up and never breaks
